translations.about-page.hero.lede: Two engineers from Cameroon, one platform, and a single conviction: an entrepreneur in Yaoundé should not pay four times more than one in Paris for the same work.
translations.about-page.commitments.title: What we hold to
translations.about-page.commitments.body: World-class tools cost what a developer in San Francisco earns in an hour. That is the barrier. Everything below exists to lower it.
translations.about-page.values.title: Five words we are held to
translations.about-page.journey.title: One rung at a time
translations.about-page.vision.title: One million businesses that actually pay their founder
translations.about-page.vision.body: Not a million accounts created. A million African businesses that earn money, by 2035. That is the only figure we measure ourselves against.
translations.about-page.contact.title: Talk to us directly
translations.about-page.commitments.free.title: Start without paying
translations.about-page.commitments.free.description: Describe your project, see every deliverable, pay only for what you keep. No card asked for.
translations.about-page.commitments.price.title: Priced for the continent
translations.about-page.commitments.price.description: Three to five times below the international platforms, billed in CFA francs, paid by Mobile Money.
translations.about-page.commitments.open.title: Readable, forkable, yours
translations.about-page.commitments.open.description: The whole codebase is public, under Apache 2.0 with the Commons Clause. Audit it, run it on your own machine, deliver client work with it. Reselling IDEM itself is the one thing it rules out.
translations.about-page.values.sovereignty.title: African sovereignty
translations.about-page.values.sovereignty.descriptio: Every technical choice is weighed against one question: who keeps control of the code and the data.
translations.about-page.values.discipline.title: Discipline
translations.about-page.values.discipline.description: We ship what works. A feature that cannot be explained in one sentence is not finished.
translations.about-page.values.passion.title: Passion
translations.about-page.values.passion.description: We build for the entrepreneurs we grew up around, and we use the platform for our own company.
translations.about-page.values.patience.title: Patience
translations.about-page.values.patience.description: Infrastructure takes years. We would rather be solid in five years than loud this quarter.
translations.about-page.values.perseverance.title: Perseverance
translations.about-page.values.perseverance.descripti: Power cuts, payment rails, bandwidth. The obstacles are known, and none of them is a reason to stop.
translations.about-page.milestones.foundation.title: IDEM is founded in Douala
translations.about-page.milestones.foundation.descrip: Two co-founders, one question: why does a Cameroonian entrepreneur pay four times more for the same tooling?
translations.about-page.milestones.mvp.title: First public version
translations.about-page.milestones.mvp.description: Brand identity, business plan, website and go-live, generated end to end from a single description.
translations.about-page.milestones.openSource.title: The codebase goes public
translations.about-page.milestones.openSource.descrip: Everything released under Apache 2.0, with self-hosting documented so nobody depends on us to keep running.
translations.about-page.milestones.expansion.title: Hosting on the continent
translations.about-page.milestones.expansion.descript: Data centres and payment partners country by country, so latency and currency stop being obstacles.
